title: Josiah knows about Max's mixtape and private beach motel

tellings.quote: stuff and Josiah wrote something about your music is being banded together you love your sacred time at the motel

plain: A nonspeaking boy named Josiah, one of the children in The Telepathy Tapes, a documentary about children said to read minds, is said to have known private things about a man named Max Davis. According to the documentary maker Ky Dickens, Josiah wrote "your music is being banded together", which she ties to a mixtape Davis was making, and "you love your sacred time at the motel", which she ties to a private beach motel he loves on the Gulf of Mexico coast. If true, it would mean the boy picked up things he had no ordinary way to know.
